northStar: QuantML-Qlib 48篇合集的方法过我们的gate. 核心洞察: 23个被否假设全是feature侧, 从未测过'模型class/目标函数'是否漏信号. 这是唯一未测轴. 用户要求Tier1+2+3顺序全做. 每个实验: 同factor_lab特征 → 换模型/目标 → 两阶段(Phase-1廉价OOS RankIC walk-forward → Phase-2 book Δα walk-forward + skeptic DSR/placebo/PBO). apples-to-apples唯一差异=模型/目标. 诚实预期: LGBM是截面tabular极强基线, 多数REJECT; 警惕PoC IC(0.023-0.087)=我们LGBM样本内0.44→OOS0.18的同类. 生产线V12.31冻结(R05).
acceptanceCriteria: 每个非skip task产出工件 + research/verdicts/QML-*.json
每实验Phase-1有OOS RankIC walk-forward裁决; 仅改善者进Phase-2 book Δα gate
Phase-2必带skeptic_report(DSR n_trials=模型变体数×3 + placebo + PBO)
生产线指纹未变(v12_scoring.py+生产模型hash基线一致)

preRegisteredGate.note: 启动写死(R01); 分regime(R11); 廉价闸先行(R16); 多重检验含DoF(R15); 只认walk-forward(R03)
preRegisteredGate.baseline: r20_v16 同特征同超参 objective=regression(MSE)+spearman_ic早停, 月度walk-forward重训(非固定生产模型, 隔离唯一差异=模型/目标)

phase1_screen.method: walk-forward(24月lookback, TEST_MONTHS 19月)重训候选 vs baseline, 测试月OOS RankIC(pred vs r20_fresh因果), 月度序列NW-t
phase1_screen.gate: 候选mean OOS RankIC > baseline 且差异NW-t>=2 → 进Phase-2; 否则廉价REJECT(模型/目标不漏信号)

phase2_gate.method: 候选模型接V7c dual-track book walk-forward(oa_gate/walk_forward_validation同harness, 唯一差异=r20源), Δα vs baseline-r20 book
phase2_gate.gate: c1 Δα>=+0.30pp; c2-c4 Sharpe/最差月/正α月占比不低于base; c5剔outlier后>0; c6各regime不为负; c7 skeptic(bootstrap p<0.05 + PBO<=0.5 + DSR含DoF)
phase2_gate.verdict: 全过PASS; 0<Δα<0.30不伤=真小; 否则REJECT. 负/真小=合法完成(R02)

phase1.no_improve: 廉价REJECT, 该模型轴不漏信号, 文档化

phase2.PASS: 真增量→记LAND候选独立评估不动V12.31

features.notes: research/qml1_ranking_obj.py 19月walk-forward. **REJECT_cheap**: regression(base) OOS RankIC=+0.1145 vs lambdarank +0.0744(Δ-0.0400 NW-t-3.66) / rank_xendcg +0.0800(Δ-0.0345 NW-t-2.68). 排序目标显著劣于回归(NW-t<-2.6, 仅3-4/19月胜base). 文章33'MSE错配'假设不成立: 回归+spearman_ic早停已优化排序信号, r20分桶给lambdarank反丢信息. 目标函数不漏信号, 无Phase-2. verdict QML-1.json.
